title: Scalable Beckmann Maps Improve One-step Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.28286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Beckmann Transport Models (BTM) learn one-step generative maps end-to-end from data, without a teacher, a distillation stage, or pretrained features. We introduce Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM), which bring to BTM the two ingredients behind the quality of modern multistep generators: classifier-free guidance (CFG) and a training recipe that scales, while keeping sampling at a single network evaluation. CFG combines conditional and unconditional velocity or score predictions, which a Beckmann map does not have. Our guidance rests on one observation: the BTM current is a positive multiple of an autonomous denoising field, to which CFG applies as it does to a velocity. With exact denoisers this gives guided BTM. In practice we substitute the map's own conditional and null predictions for the denoisers, which requires no additional network and introduces a bias that we characterize. translated_title: 可扩展Beckmann映射改进单步生成
translated_abstract: Beckmann输运模型（BTM）直接从数据端到端地学习单步生成映射，无需教师模型、蒸馏阶段或预训练特征。我们提出了可扩展Beckmann映射（SBM），它为BTM带来了现代多步生成器高质量背后的两个关键要素：无分类器引导（CFG）以及可扩展的训练配方，同时保持采样仅需单次网络评估。CFG结合了条件与无条件的速度或得分预测，而Beckmann映射本身并不具备这一点。我们的引导方法基于一个观察：BTM流是一个自治去噪场的正倍数，因此CFG可以像应用于速度场那样应用于它。在具有精确去噪器的情况下，这给出了引导式BTM。在实践中，我们用映射自身的条件预测和空预测来替代去噪器，这无需额外的网络，并引入了一个我们加以刻画的偏差。我们证明了该引导更新与引导化的一致性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出可扩展Beckmann映射（SBM），首次将无分类器引导（CFG）和可扩展训练配方引入无需教师模型与蒸馏的Beckmann输运模型，在保持单次网络评估采样的同时提升单步生成质量。
en_tdlr: Scalable Beckmann Maps (SBM) bring classifier-free guidance and a scalable training recipe to teacher-free Beckmann Transport Models, improving one-step generation quality while retaining single-network-evaluation sampling.
